description: A man in a dark waistcoat and white shirt sits on a wooden chair at a slanted drafting desk in a dim room, drawing angular black letters with a pen on a large sheet of paper. Ink pots and a pen sit on the desk ledge, and books and rolled papers are on shelves behind him. On the right, a white board with a red ring and dark horizontal bar, like a transport roundel, leans against the wall beside posters of more lettering. Window light comes from the left, and the scene is painted in a dark oil style.
